raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.15.0) (oldest at bottom):
* __->__ #5398

spmd_types collectives wait on the NCCL result right after issuing it, so
module-boundary redistributes (e.g. the sequence-parallel all-gather before
attention/MLP and the reduce-scatter after) never overlap with compute in
eager mode. The DTensor backend avoided this by calling
`redistribute(..., async_op=True)` at exactly these boundaries.

spmd_types now has the same opt-in (meta-pytorch/spmd_types@fce1acb:
`async_op`, forward only by default; `backward_options={"async_op": True}`
for backward). This bumps the spmd_types pin to that commit and passes
`async_op=True` through `spmd_redistribute_per_axis` from the two
module-boundary call sites in `Module`. Backward collectives still wait.

@@ -399,13 +399,21 @@ def spmd_redistribute_per_axis(
     mesh: DeviceMesh | None,
     src: spmd.SpmdType,
     dst: spmd.SpmdType,
+    *,
+    async_op: bool,
 ) -> torch.Tensor:
     """Redistribute a local tensor along axes whose SPMD type changes.
 
     Iterates over *dst_types* and issues a per-axis ``spmd.redistribute``
     for each axis where src and dst differ. Each call is a single collective
     (all-reduce, reduce-scatter, or all-gather) on that axis's process group.
 
+    ``async_op`` is required so callers choose explicitly. With
+    ``async_op=True`` the forward collectives return without waiting; the
+    first op that consumes the result waits on it (a stream wait), so the
+    collective can overlap with compute issued in between. Backward
+    collectives still wait.
+
     TODO(pianpwk): Move into ``spmd_types`` as a version that takes
     per-axis types + ``PartitionSpec``, so the library handles multi-axis
     redistribute ordering internally.
@@ -431,6 +439,7 @@ def spmd_redistribute_per_axis(
             mesh.get_group(axis),
             src=src_t,
             dst=dst_t,
+            async_op=async_op,
             backward_options={"op_dtype": x.dtype},
         )
     return x

                 spmd.assert_type(value, src_spmd_layout)
 
             if dst_spmd_layout is not None:
+                # Module-boundary collectives (e.g. the sequence-parallel
+                # all-gather) overlap with compute until first use.
                 value = spmd_redistribute_per_axis(
                     value,
                     current_spmd_mesh(),
                     src_spmd_layout,
                     dst_spmd_layout,
+                    async_op=True,
                 )
             new_kwargs[name] = value
